export_evidence: ImportKey India customs record (https://importkey.com/countries/india/instapower-limited): "2025-06-23 | INSTAPOWER LIMITED | EASTERN ELECTRICAL ENTERPRISES | LED LOW INTENSITY TYPE-B LIGHT OPERATINGVOLTAGE 90-270V AC LED LIGHT COLOUR -RED | SONAULI LCS INSNLB, India | Bhairawa, NEPAL | 94052100 | 2959185" — one outbound export row with date, destination (Nepal), HS 94052100 and B/L 2959185. Counter check: page header states "Total Shipments 65 Records detected" and "Trading Partners 2", but only 5 rows were actually visible on the free view; of those 5, 4 are imports into India (China suppliers, HS 94054900/94059900/94052100) and only 1 is an export. So export evidence rests on a single visible record, not on the 65-shipment counter.
domestic_evidence: Company website (https://www.instapower.com/) states: "We have been associated with number of prestigious projects such as Signature Bridge in Delhi, Gujarat Bhawan, MP Bhawan, Rumi Darwaza, GandhiNagar Railway Station and many more" and "Instapower product range is widely accepted in the Indian market". No GST turnover figure, no GeM/CPPP tender award, no contract document and no annual-report domestic/export split was retrievable — web_search returned no results (searx connection refused) and no public GST or tender record was located. Project references are self-declared on the company's own site, therefore 'declared, not confirmed'.
note: Exporter role is real but thin in the public record: exactly one visible export bill of lading (23.06.2025, Sonouli LCS → Bhairawa, Nepal, HS 94052100, B/L 2959185) via Eastern Electrical Enterprises. The bulk of the 65 customs rows are imports of LED housings/fixtures from Chinese suppliers (Guangzhou Crolighting, Massled Industrial, Changshu Smile, Hunan Lingte) — i.e. the company is primarily an importer/assembler, not a volume exporter. Declared HS codes 853921/940511/940542 do not match the observed records: export row is 94052100 and import rows are 94054900/94059900 — HS should be corrected to the factual codes (accepted_hs_corrected per rule 3), no rejection. Revenue and export volume: null — no public figures found, not estimated. Domestic supply: only self-declared project references on own website; no GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP award or contract located, so 'declared_only'. No sanctions/court data checked (out of scope for this role).
